subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this Google Chat `NO_REPLY` placeholder cleanup, or close it and queue a replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an unmerged closing PR already claims it, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 as the candidate path if it can be refreshed against current main and proven with a real Google Chat run.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close the fork PR if it is not maintainable, then queue a narrow OpenClaw-owned replacement that preserves contributor credit where appropriate.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue open without a new repair only if maintainers expect the fork author to provide proof or updates soon.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 as the candidate path if it can be refreshed against current main and proven with a real Google Chat run.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery work makes this the best available routing owner for the landing-path decision.
